title: AI Engineer
description: Marktlink supports entrepreneurs at every stage of their business journey. As an independent international M&A advisor, Marktlink combines deep market knowledge with a personal and pragmatic approach. Together with our label Marktlink Exit-Ready and other services such as Transaction Services, Legal and Debt Advisory, we support entrepreneurs by preparing their business for sale and guide them throughout the entire sales or acquisition process. Our label Marktlink Capital offers entrepreneurs the opportunity to invest in strong private equity and venture capital funds.Since our start in 1996, entrepreneurs have been our driving force. With a profound market knowledge and a personal approach, we advised many transactions and in doing so we influenced the lives of many.Your goalAI is reshaping the way Marktlink works and you're one of the people building that future. As an AI Engineer, you design and develop solutions that make M&A professionals faster, smarter and better informed: from intelligent agents that automate recurring tasks to systems that put the right knowledge in front of the right person at the right moment. You own your projects from first idea to live deployment, and you see the impact land directly inside the business.Your responsibilitiesBuild multi-agent systems that communicate with users and connect to internal systems;Work on AI projects end to end, from brainstorming features and building the business case to developing, testing, deploying and continuously improving the solution.Develop RAG pipelines with vector embeddings to make our knowledge and data safely accessible;Translate business needs into concrete technical solutions and align on priorities with your team and stakeholders;Choose the right technical approach per challenge;Make AI output measurable: build test sets and evaluate for accuracy, hallucinations, cost and latency;Bring solutions to production and keep them reliable, secure and maintainable;Track adoption, gather feedback and iterate based on real results;Stay sharp on new developments in AI and bring relevant ideas back to the team.Your profileA completed Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Econometrics or a comparable field. Preferably recently graduated or with your first work experience;Fluency in Dutch is required;Strong Python skills: you understand your code and debug it when things break;Hands-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering and connecting AI to internal data. Either via RAG, tool use or MCP;Familiar with AI-coding agents and able to assess generated code critically;Basic Git knowledge; experience with CI/CD, API integrations or Azure (Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Foundry) is a plus;Analytically strong and able to explain technical choices clearly to both engineers and non-technical colleagues;Curious, proactive and pragmatic, you feel at home in an environment where the landscape shifts fast.Why us?At Marktlink, we’re not just dealmakers, we’re future-shapers. With a strong focus on tech, data, and AI, we’re redefining the world of M&A. Here’s what you can expect when you join our fast-growing, entrepreneurial team:Work on AI that goes live inside a real, fast-growing M&A firm. Your output changes how professionals work day to day;A close AI, Data & AI team that encourages experimentation and honest feedback;Unlimited holidays. A unique blend of freedom and responsibility;Competitive salary and annual bonus;Pension plan via ASR;HP laptop and iPhone;Responsibility from day one, with flexible working hours and entrepreneurial colleagues;Tailor-made training and personal development;Opportunity to participate in our funds under favorable conditions;Yearly company ski-trip, Marktlink Gala & Marktlink Connect.At Marktlink, we believe diverse teams deliver better results for our clients. Entrepreneurs don't always follow fixed paths and neither do we. We value equal opportunity and welcome different backgrounds, perspectives and experiences.Don't meet every requirement? That's okay. We know great people don't always fit every box. If you have the drive, curiosity and ownership to thrive in a fast-paced, deal-driven environment, we encourage you to apply. Show more Show less
